options.content: Per-**Exchange** orderbook and MPC ladder views for the selected diagnostics frame. Depth curves use `price - mid` on the x-axis. **Marginal ladder**, **After venue rounding**, and **Exchange-accepted placements** use uniform spread buckets (Spread max / Spread buckets) with bid/ask bars aligned across panels.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT e.ts AS diag_ts,
         e.payload AS diag_payload,
         e.exchange AS exchange,
         e.symbol,
         e.actor_id,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS t_end_ms,
         COALESCE(
           (
             CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook','bids','0','price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook','bids','0','price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END +
             CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook','asks','0','price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook','asks','0','price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END
           ) / 2.0,
           CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
           0.0
         ) AS mid,
         GREATEST(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 100.0
END, 1.0) AS spread_max
  FROM mm_events e
  
  WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
    
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
selected AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           (
             CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload #>> ARRAY['orderbook','bids','0','price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload #>> ARRAY['orderbook','bids','0','price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END +
             CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload #>> ARRAY['orderbook','asks','0','price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload #>> ARRAY['orderbook','asks','0','price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END
           ) / 2.0,
           NULLIF(ctx.mid, 0.0),
           0.0
         ) AS mid,
         ctx.spread_max,
         m.payload
  FROM ctx
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT m.payload, m.ts
    FROM mm_events m
    WHERE m.event_type = 'MarketEvent'
      AND m.exchange = ctx.exchange
      AND m.symbol = ctx.symbol
      AND m.payload->>'t_end_ms' IS NOT NULL
      AND (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) <= ctx.t_end_ms
      AND $__timeFilter(m.ts)
      AND (NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '') IS NULL OR COALESCE(NULLIF(m.payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(m.topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) = NULLIF('${interval_ms}', ''))
    ORDER BY (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(m.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) DESC, m.ts DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) m ON TRUE
),
bid_levels AS (
  SELECT CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(b->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(b->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(b->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(b->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM selected, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(payload->'orderbook'->'bids', '[]'::jsonb)) AS b
),
ask_levels AS (
  SELECT CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(a->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(a->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(a->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(a->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM selected, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(payload->'orderbook'->'asks', '[]'::jsonb)) AS a
),
bid_step AS (
  SELECT (l.price - selected.mid) AS spread,
         SUM(l.qty) OVER (ORDER BY l.price DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value
  FROM selected
  JOIN bid_levels l ON TRUE
  WHERE l.price IS NOT NULL
    AND l.qty > 0
    AND (l.price - selected.mid) >= -selected.spread_max
    AND (l.price - selected.mid) <= 0
),
ask_step AS (
  SELECT (l.price - selected.mid) AS spread,
         SUM(l.qty) OVER (ORDER BY l.price ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value
  FROM selected
  JOIN ask_levels l ON TRUE
  WHERE l.price IS NOT NULL
    AND l.qty > 0
    AND (l.price - selected.mid) >= 0
    AND (l.price - selected.mid) <= selected.spread_max
),
bid_step_plot AS (
  SELECT spread, value FROM bid_step
  UNION ALL
  SELECT -selected.spread_max,
         (SELECT value FROM bid_step ORDER BY spread ASC LIMIT 1)
  FROM selected
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bid_step)
),
ask_step_plot AS (
  SELECT spread, value FROM ask_step
  UNION ALL
  SELECT selected.spread_max,
         (SELECT value FROM ask_step ORDER BY spread DESC LIMIT 1)
  FROM selected
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ask_step)
)
SELECT 'bid'::text AS side,
       spread,
       value
FROM bid_step_plot
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ask'::text AS side,
       spread,
       value
FROM ask_step_plot
ORDER BY side, spread

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT e.exchange,
         e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
    AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND (
      '${target_frame_mode}' = 'latest'
      OR e.event_id = ${target_frame_event_id:sqlstring}
    )
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
selected AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['state', 'mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['state', 'mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
           (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook', 'bids', '0', 'price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook', 'bids', '0', 'price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END + CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook', 'asks', '0', 'price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(l.payload #>> ARRAY['cleared_orderbook', 'asks', '0', 'price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 2.0,
           0.0
         ) AS mid,
         GREATEST(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE('${spread_max}', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 100.0
END, 1.0) AS spread_max
  FROM latest l
),
bid_levels AS (
  SELECT CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']
  ELSE '[]'::jsonb
END
  ) AS o(value)
  WHERE CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END = 'bid'
    AND CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', l.exchange, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
),
ask_levels AS (
  SELECT CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders']
  WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']) > 0 THEN l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders_sample']
  ELSE '[]'::jsonb
END
  ) AS o(value)
  WHERE CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END = 'ask'
    AND CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', l.exchange, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
),
bid_step AS (
  SELECT (l.price - selected.mid) AS spread,
         SUM(l.qty) OVER (ORDER BY l.price DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value
  FROM selected
  JOIN bid_levels l ON TRUE
  WHERE l.price IS NOT NULL
    AND l.qty > 0
    AND (l.price - selected.mid) >= -selected.spread_max
    AND (l.price - selected.mid) <= 0
),
ask_step AS (
  SELECT (l.price - selected.mid) AS spread,
         SUM(l.qty) OVER (ORDER BY l.price ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value
  FROM selected
  JOIN ask_levels l ON TRUE
  WHERE l.price IS NOT NULL
    AND l.qty > 0
    AND (l.price - selected.mid) >= 0
    AND (l.price - selected.mid) <= selected.spread_max
),
bid_step_plot AS (
  SELECT spread, value FROM bid_step
  UNION ALL
  SELECT -selected.spread_max,
         (SELECT value FROM bid_step ORDER BY spread ASC LIMIT 1)
  FROM selected
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bid_step)
),
ask_step_plot AS (
  SELECT spread, value FROM ask_step
  UNION ALL
  SELECT selected.spread_max,
         (SELECT value FROM ask_step ORDER BY spread DESC LIMIT 1)
  FROM selected
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ask_step)
)

       spread,
       value
FROM bid_step_plot
UNION ALL

       value
FROM ask_step_plot
ORDER BY side, spread

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(
      exchange,
      payload->>'exchange',
      substring(topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'),
      substring(topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$')
    ) AS exchange,
    ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substring(topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):errors$') AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE topic LIKE 'private:state:%:errors'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

SELECT interval_ms
FROM (
  SELECT interval_ms, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) AS interval_ms, ts AS latest_ts
    FROM mm_events
    WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT interval_ms::text AS interval_ms, ts AS latest_ts
    FROM mm_market_facts
    WHERE interval_ms IS NOT NULL
  ) sources
  GROUP BY interval_ms
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

SELECT
  e.event_id AS __value,
  (
    'step ' || COALESCE(e.payload->>'frame_step', '?')
    || ' / t_end ' || COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '?')
    || ' / created ' || COALESCE(e.payload->>'created_at_ms', '?')
  ) AS __text
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 100
